answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 35485 Country: India Title: Islamic Names Question: Allah has recently blessed me with a son. Now I want to name my son Shahan Alam (meaning of Shahan is king as per internet site) my name is Shadab Alam Ansari, I would like to urge you that please tell me is Shahan Alam is valid as per Islam. Answer ID: 35485 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1854/1303/L=1432) You can name your son with Shah Alam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
